law: Every public entrypoint budget is decrease-only in BOTH governed dimensions (maxReachableModules, maxSourceBytes). Raising a ceiling requires --write-baseline --widen with a measured reason; lowering one requires updating this anchor in the same change. Unknown root keys and unknown ceiling dimensions fail the gate; they are never ignored.
why: This file makes both governed entrypoint budget dimensions -- reachable modules and source bytes -- executable and reviewable instead of relying on narrative notes.
